text.description_html:
Don-Jo RP-13509, Remodeler Plate

This 3-1/2 Inch x 9 Inch Remodeler Plate is available in satin stainless steel or polished brass finishes. Plates like this one can be used in a variety of applications. The most common is to cover up damage that is on the door around the door knob or lock. Another use is to cover up existing holes in the door. This plate can also be used as an escutcheon or rose behind a door knob or lever.

Features and Specifications of the 9" x 3-1/2" Remodel Plate:

  • Height: 9"
  • Width: 3-1/2"
  • Hole Diameter: 2-1/8" (2.125")
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.
  • Don-Jo RP-13509 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

When Selecting a Finish: The Base Material is Determined by the Finish

  • Satin Stainless Steel Finish -- Stainless Steel Base Material
  • Polished Brass Finish -- Brass Base Material

Sold Individually for one (1) side of a door
